problem: How many $3$-letter words (legitimate or made-up) can be made using the letters of the word DOCUMENTARY, where each letter cannot appear in the word more than once?

feedback.worked_solution:
The formula for ${}_{n}{P}_{r}$ is given by

$$
{}_{n}{P}_{r}=\frac{n!}{(n-r)!}\,.
$$

$P(10,9)$ means the same thing as ${}_{10}{P}_{9}.$ Using the usual formula for ${}_{n}{P}_{r},$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}P(10,9) & =\frac{10!}{(10-9)!} \\  & =\frac{10!}{1!} \\  & =10\cdot 9\cdot 8\cdot 7\cdot 6\cdot 5\cdot 4\cdot 3\cdot 2\cdot 1 \\  & =3\,628\,800.\end{aligned}
$$
